description: For up to 16 token addresses: price, liquidity and 24h volume summed over their pools, price change over 5m/1h/6h/24h, buys and sells, how many pools and when the first opened, the deepest pools, and (when known) holder count, top-10 holder share, GeckoTerminal's score and honeypot flag. Check liquidity before sizing any trade in a token you do not know.
name: get_token_market
title: Liquidity, volume and momentum for tokens
